name: sitesplat/bbopengraph
description: A solid social meta tag plugin is the foundation of any good social strategy — BBopenGraph gives you total control over all the information social website crawlers need, improving Google Search ranking, social engagement, and click-through-rates on Facebook, Google+, Twitter, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and many more — independently of any social sharing buttons you may or may not already use. This also comes with a special sharing button system and support for BBtags out of the box.
